needs.title: Pin the test-job GitHub Actions to immutable commit SHAs
needs.what_is_missing_or_wrong: The test job uses mutable action tags, so its execution can change without a repository change; the adjacent CommitLore job already follows immutable pinning.
needs.what_done_would_look_like: Replace `actions/checkout@v4` and `actions/setup-python@v5` with reviewed full commit SHAs and version comments, matching the pattern used by the CommitLore job.
tree_evidence: .github/workflows/ci.yml:17 uses a full SHA for checkout.
.github/workflows/ci.yml:20 uses a full SHA for setup-node.
.github/workflows/ci.yml:38-39 use mutable `@v4` and `@v5` tags in the test job.
needs.distinct_from_others_because: This addresses CI supply-chain reproducibility, not Python dependency compatibility or test isolation.

needs.title: Make the development pytest requirement match CI's supported range
needs.what_is_missing_or_wrong: Contributors installing the declared `dev` extra can receive a newer pytest major version than CI exercises, because the project allows all pytest versions from 8 onward while CI deliberately caps below 9.
needs.what_done_would_look_like: Use one compatible pytest constraint for both the `dev` extra and CI—either by bounding `dev` to the CI range or by updating CI and verifying the newer major version.
needs.distinct_from_others_because: This keeps contributor and CI test environments compatible; it does not concern action integrity or outbound-network enforcement.

needs.title: Close the test suite's network-isolation bypasses
needs.what_is_missing_or_wrong: The autouse fixture claims tests must not reach the network, but it blocks only `urllib.request.urlopen`. A future use of another HTTP client or raw sockets would make real outbound requests without failing the suite.
needs.what_done_would_look_like: Extend the fixture to block an appropriate lower-level connection path (while preserving legitimate local test behavior) and add tests proving direct-socket and non-`urlopen` access are rejected.
tree_evidence: tests/conftest.py:10 states the intended invariant: `tests must not reach the network`.
needs.distinct_from_others_because: This protects test determinism and prevents accidental live I/O, independently of CI dependency/action configuration.

ranking.why_not_the_scout_order: The scout's own ordering could reflect what it found easiest to describe, and a quality score would let an operator prefer the need that looks likely to build. A hash of the need's own content is fixed before anyone knows which one survives.
